component.name: Live for Speed Linux
component.summary: Unofficial community Linux launcher for Live for Speed

description.p: Live for Speed Linux is an unofficial community launcher for the untouched official Live for Speed Windows build.

On first launch, one informed setup prompt downloads official files, verifies every immutable game and Wine runtime file, configures exact Wine 11.15-1 and DXVK, and starts the game. Later launches use the direct low-overhead path.
Live for Speed is proprietary software from Scawen Roberts, Eric Bailey, and Victor van Vlaardingen. This community wrapper is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Live for Speed developers.
Add plain-language support forms, deterministic ticket triage, contributor queues, and a compact maintainer dashboard.
Introduce the original text-free Velocity L icon for clear rendering at desktop and menu sizes.
Adopt the Live for Speed Linux name and a new community-owned website design.
Adopt a descriptive public name while preserving the command and player state paths.
Initial community wrapper with verified downloads, private DXVK, diagnostics, and AUR packaging.
